WITH per_frequency AS (
    SELECT
        a.frequency,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
    GROUP BY a.frequency
),
mean_signed_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS mean_signed_average
    FROM per_frequency
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_average,
    AVG(p.avg_balance) AS avg_balance_average,
    AVG(p.avg_signed_amount - m.mean_signed_average) AS avg_excess_over_mean
FROM per_frequency AS p
CROSS JOIN mean_signed_average AS m
WHERE p.avg_signed_amount > m.mean_signed_average;
